query-produce-verify.label: Observe, Produce, Verify
query-produce-verify.description: Observe current Project Tasks, produce the requested durable resource, and independently verify the settled result.

inspect.description: Observe the current Project Task list and report the actual result or precise error.

produce.description: Create and publish the requested text resource after the observation is available.

verify.description: Independently verify original requirements against the settled producer result and immutable resource.
